note: A1+ Unit 6 Lesson 6.14, built on 2026-11-20 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. The user asked on 2026-11-20 "Lets work on a1+ Unit 6 same all deal as before none stop all approved" (A1+ 6.Y follows A1 6.Y, one step each; fifteen lessons; the Units 2-4 deal: straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview). The review uses twelve new Flash photos of new people and places, one per Unit 6 step (and one remake: the first platform-nine photo had a 2 on the carriage). Each fact is offered as a picture item, whose wrong pictures are the other photos, and as a sentence item, whose wrong options change only the reviewed form.

lesson.title: 6.14 Review: trips around town
lesson.unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson.goal: Review every A1+ Unit 6 step with new people: places near here, how people go to work and what for, platforms, travel things, corners, turns, bridges, what you can't do, polite questions, tickets, being late and the hotel, with no new language.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.14 Three Trips Around Town: A1 reviews Unit 6 through fresh scenes; A1+ 6.14 reviews every A1+ Unit 6 step with twelve fresh photos of new people and no new language: a bookstore near here (6.1), the subway to work (6.2), going to the bakery to buy bread (6.3), platform nine (6.4), Don't forget your backpack! (6.5), a gas station on the corner (6.6), turning left at a police station (6.7), crossing a bridge (6.8), You can't swim here. (6.9), Could you tell me where …? (6.10), a round-trip ticket (6.11), a late bus (6.12) and Here's your key. (6.13). Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person, so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers. A sentence a photo cannot decide (which ticket a buyer asks for, which floor a room is on) is never set against the photo.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Ask for and give travel information about new people and places with every Unit 6 form, at a natural pace.
